select r.id, r.product_id as productId, r.task_id as taskId, r.quality_grade as qualityGrade, r.brand_model as brandModel, r.defect_summary as defectSummary, r.price_min as priceMin, r.price_max as priceMax, r.confidence as confidence, r.status, r.create_time as createTime, p.title as productTitle, p.status as productStatus, (select pi.url from sm_product_image pi where pi.product_id = p.id order by pi.sort limit 1) as productImage from sm_inspection_report r left join sm_product p on r.product_id = p.id
order by r.create_time desc offset #{offset} limit #{limit}
select count(*) from sm_inspection_report r left join sm_product p on r.product_id = p.id

select r.*, p.title as productTitle, t.photo_urls as photoUrls, t.model_name as modelName, t.duration_ms as durationMs from sm_inspection_report r left join sm_product p on r.product_id = p.id left join sm_inspection_task t on r.task_id = t.id where r.id = #{reportId}
select defect_type as defectType, position, severity, description, image_url as imageUrl from sm_inspection_defect where report_id = #{reportId} order by sort
